title: August settings (~/.august/config.json)
description: API keys and the Telegram bot token are not here; they live in ~/.august/.env.

provider.description: Who runs the model; `august login` sets it up.

name.description: Model id; /model lists what the provider offers.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Anthropic also takes xhigh and max.

web_search.description: Let the model use the provider's built-in web search.

approvals.description: Ask before dangerous shell commands (rm -rf, sudo, git push, ...).

compact_at.description: Summarize the conversation once a request's context exceeds this many tokens.

review_every.description: Review the conversation and update memory and skills every N user messages; 0 turns it off.

allowed.description: Telegram user ids allowed to talk to the bot.

model.description: OpenAI model that transcribes voice messages (needs OPENAI_API_KEY in .env).

update.description: How `august update` gets new versions. Not written to the file while it has its default.

from_source.description: Follow every commit on master and build it on this machine (needs git and cargo) instead of installing release binaries.
